1→import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
     2→import { useLoaderData } from "react-router";
     3→import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
     4→import db from "../db.server";
     5→import { PLANS, getPlan } from "../lib/plans";
     6→
     7→export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
     8→  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
     9→  const subscription = await db.subscription.findUnique({ where: { shop: session.shop } });
    10→  return { currentPlan: getPlan(subscription?.planId ?? "free"), plans: PLANS };
    11→};
    12→
    13→export default function Pricing() {
    14→  const { currentPlan, plans } = useLoaderData<typeof loader>();
    15→
    16→  return (
    17→    <s-page heading="Plans & Pricing">
    18→      <s-section>
    19→        <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
    20→          <s-heading>Simple, transparent pricing. No per-order fees. No hidden charges. Ever.</s-heading>
    21→          <s-text tone="neutral">
    22→            Current plan: {currentPlan.name}{currentPlan.price > 0 ? ` ($${currentPlan.price}/mo)` : " (Free)"}
    23→          </s-text>
    24→        </s-stack>
    25→      </s-section>
    26→
    27→      <s-section>
    28→        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
    29→          {plans.map((plan) => {
    30→            const isCurrent = plan.id === currentPlan.id;
    31→            const isUpgrade = plans.indexOf(plan) > plans.indexOf(currentPlan);
    32→
    33→            return (
    34→              <s-box key={plan.id} padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base" background={isCurrent ? "subdued" : undefined}>
    35→                <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
    36→                  <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
    37→                    <s-heading>{plan.name}</s-heading>
    38→                    <s-text>
    39→                      {plan.price === 0 ? "Free" : `$${plan.price}/month`}
    40→                    </s-text>
    41→                    {plan.price > 0 && (
    42→                      <s-text tone="neutral">or ${plan.annualPrice}/year (save 20%)</s-text>
    43→                    )}
    44→                  </s-stack>
    45→
    46→                  <s-unordered-list>
    47→                    {plan.features.map((feature, i) => (
    48→                      <s-list-item key={i}>{feature}</s-list-item>
    49→                    ))}
    50→                  </s-unordered-list>
    51→
    52→                  {isCurrent ? (
    53→                    <s-button disabled>Current Plan</s-button>
    54→                  ) : isUpgrade ? (
    55→                    <s-button variant="primary">Upgrade to {plan.name}</s-button>
    56→                  ) : (
    57→                    <s-button variant="tertiary">Downgrade to {plan.name}</s-button>
    58→                  )}
    59→                </s-stack>
    60→              </s-box>
    61→            );
    62→          })}
    63→        </s-stack>
    64→      </s-section>
    65→
    66→      <s-section heading="Why Merchants Switch to Us">
    67→        <s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">
    68→          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
    69→            <s-text>No Per-Order Fees</s-text>
    70→            <s-text tone="neutral">
    71→              Unlike competitors who charge per order, we use simple flat pricing. No surprises.
    72→            </s-text>
    73→          </s-box>
    74→          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
    75→            <s-text>No Watermark on Free</s-text>
    76→            <s-text tone="neutral">
    77→              Even our free plan has no watermark. Your store stays clean and professional.
    78→            </s-text>
    79→          </s-box>
    80→          <s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">
    81→            <s-text>20% Annual Discount</s-text>
    82→            <s-text tone="neutral">
    83→              Pay annually and save 2 months. Cancel anytime.
    84→            </s-text>
    85→          </s-box>
    86→        </s-stack>
    87→      </s-section>
    88→
    89→      <s-section slot="aside" heading="FAQ">
    90→        <s-stack direction="block" gap="base">
    91→          <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
    92→            <s-text>Can I switch plans anytime?</s-text>
    93→            <s-text tone="neutral">Yes. Upgrade instantly, downgrade at end of billing period.</s-text>
    94→          </s-stack>
    95→          <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
    96→            <s-text>What happens to my charts if I downgrade?</s-text>
    97→            <s-text tone="neutral">Charts are never deleted. On Free, only the 3 most recent stay published.</s-text>
    98→          </s-stack>
    99→          <s-stack direction="block" gap="small-200">
   100→            <s-text>Is there a free trial?</s-text>
   101→            <s-text tone="neutral">The free plan is permanent — not a trial. Upgrade when you need more.</s-text>
   102→          </s-stack>
   103→        </s-stack>
   104→      </s-section>
   105→    </s-page>
